observations: Single photo shows one headlamp unit wrapped in clear plastic, resting on a concrete/tiled floor.
A watermark text reads 'HONDA AND ACURA' across the image, which appears to be a seller/store logo overlay, not a manufacturer marking on the actual part.
No visible part number, OEM markings, or vehicle-specific badging on the lamp itself.
No chrome/housing damage visible due to plastic wrap and glare, but a crease is visible in the plastic near the bottom.
Only one item photographed despite the seller's text claiming a wide range of body, engine, and suspension parts for Honda, Acura, Toyota.

read_from: photo 0 watermark (seller branding, not a part marking)

risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/lower condition if ever priced.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as aftermarket/unbranded if ever priced.

proof_requests: Photo of the headlamp unwrapped, showing any part number or OEM markings on the back/connector.
Confirmation of the specific car make/model/year this headlamp is meant for.

response.reason: The single photo shows a generic, plastic-wrapped headlamp with no readable model or vehicle identification, so even a worst-case price cannot be matched to the vehicle-specific comparables provided.
